contracts.purpose: Documents raster-profile and sample-axis semantics that are specific to WellPlot.

field_semantics.profile: The semantic interpretation family of raster samples.
field_semantics.sample_axis: The coordinate system of samples within this raster binding.

distinctions: track.x_scale is the horizontal domain of the array track.
binding.sample_axis is the coordinate system within the raster binding.
track.x_scale and binding.sample_axis represent different semantic dimensions.
Do not copy track.x_scale into sample_axis.minimum or sample_axis.maximum unless the request independently specifies those sample-axis bounds.
